title: Conference of Power Ministers Opens in New Delhi Under Union Minister Manohar Lal
summary: The Conference of Power Ministers convened in New Delhi on 27–28 November 2026 with participation from 28 states and 8 union territories to review grid modernization, renewable capacity, and distribution reforms.

title: CSIR-IIIM Jammu Wins DIDAC India Award; India Ranks 38th in Global Innovation Index 2026
summary: CSIR-IIIM Jammu was honoured with a DIDAC India Award. Separately, India ranked 38th among 139 economies in WIPO's Global Innovation Index 2026 and retained the 1st spot in the lower-middle-income group.

title: India Awarded 2028 Thomas & Uber Cup Hosting Rights; Enters Women's Asian Champions Trophy Final
summary: New Delhi has been awarded hosting rights for the 2028 Thomas & Uber Cup badminton tournament. In hockey, India beat Malaysia 6-2 in Bhopal to reach the Women's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 final against China.

title: India & UAE Agree to Accelerate Joint Defence Co-Development at 14th JDCC in Abu Dhabi
summary: At the 14th India-UAE Joint Defence Cooperation Committee (JDCC) meeting in Abu Dhabi, both nations agreed to speed up co-development and co-production of next-generation defence equipment.

title: India's Seafood Exports Hit Record ₹73,890.46 Crore ($8.45B); Railways Logs 145.07 MT Freight
summary: India achieved record seafood exports of ₹73,890.46 crore across 19.32 lakh metric tonnes in 2025-26, while Indian Railways recorded 145.07 million tonnes of freight loading in October 2026.

title: ISRO & Indian Space Startups Advance Small Satellite Launch Readiness for 2027
summary: ISRO and IN-SPACe reviewed upcoming SSLV commercial missions and student satellite payloads aimed at boosting India's low-cost Earth observation network.

title: SIDBI Expands MSME Digital Credit & Green Finance Support in FY 2026–27
summary: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI), headquartered in Lucknow, launched streamlined digital credit guarantees for rural and semi-urban MSME entrepreneurs.

title: SSC Implements Aadhaar-Based Biometric & New OTR Verification for 2026–27 Exams
summary: Staff Selection Commission (SSC) expanded its upgraded One-Time Registration (OTR) and live exam city intimation portal at ssc.gov.in for CHSL, GD, and CGL candidates.

title: National Milk Day 2026 Celebrated Across India on 26 November
summary: Observed annually on 26 November to mark the birth anniversary of Dr. Verghese Kurien, the Father of India's White Revolution and founder of Operation Flood.
source: PIB / Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying

title: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Diwas) Celebrations & Awareness Drives Nationwide
summary: Observed annually on 26 November to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of India in 1949; schools and colleges host Preamble reading and polity quizzes.

title: Jammu & Kashmir Udhampur-Srinagar-Baramulla Rail Link (USBRL) Connectivity Milestone
summary: All-weather railway connectivity across the Chenab and Anji Khad bridges boosts passenger and freight movement between Jammu and the Kashmir Valley.

title: UPI Cross-Border & Offline Lite Transaction Limits Enhanced by NPCI
summary: NPCI expanded UPI Lite wallet usability for low-connectivity rural areas and strengthened instant digital payment infrastructure across India.

title: National Education Policy (NEP) Digital Skill & Vocational Credits Expansion
summary: Ministry of Education and AICTE expanded credit-linked vocational and AI skill modules for undergraduate and ITI students across Indian universities.

title: India's Renewable Energy Capacity Crosses New Solar & Hydro Benchmark
summary: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy reported record additions in solar parks and Himalayan hydroelectric projects supporting India's 2030 clean energy goals.

title: Jammu & Kashmir Digital Governance & e-Services Expansion 2026
summary: J&K administration expanded 1,100+ online citizen services on e-UNNAT portal to streamline certificate verification and recruitment documentation for JKSSB aspirants.

title: India's Chandrayaan & Gaganyaan Mission Milestones Reviewed by ISRO
summary: ISRO successfully completed key crew-module recovery and propulsion tests ahead of upcoming human spaceflight and lunar sample-return missions.

title: RBI Monetary Policy & Digital Rupee (CBDC) Offline Pilot Update
summary: Reserve Bank of India highlighted steady GDP growth projections and expanded offline retail CBDC transactions for rural and remote connectivity zones.

title: National Sports Awards & Khelo India Winter Games Preparation in J&K
summary: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports announced preparations for the upcoming Khelo India Winter Games in Gulmarg, boosting winter sports infrastructure in J&K.

title: Indian Armed Forces Induct Indigenous Air Defence & Border Surveillance Systems
summary: DRDO and Indian Defence PSUs handed over upgraded indigenous radar and counter-drone systems to strengthen northern and western border security.
